reply_text:
I saved Dana's note that they now use Dock 38 for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups, starting 2026-10-14, and replied to them in their direct message.

- **Visibility:** I asked for the note to be private. The notes system filed it as "world" visible anyway, so other people who use that system may be able to read it. I told Dana this in my reply and offered to remove the note if that's a problem.
- **Duplicates:** Search in the notes system is limited to keywords right now. So when I checked for an existing note about Dana's dock, finding nothing doesn't prove there isn't one already.
